seo.title: Som Pay — a multi-currency card and transfers in one app
seo.description: A card in UZS, USD and EUR, transfers by phone number in seconds, up to 5% cashback and a business account for sole traders. Open online in 5 minutes.
seo.answer: Som Pay is an app with a multi-currency card (UZS, USD, EUR), transfers by phone number and up to 5% cashback. The basic plan is free, Plus is 29,000 UZS a month, a business account for sole traders is 99,000 UZS a month; you can open it online in 5 minutes with your passport. Exact limits and fees are shown in the app.

sections.label: Features
sections.title: Everything your money needs
sections.intro: One account for everyday spending, travel and business.

items.title: Multi-currency card
items.text: Som, dollars and euros on one card. Exchange currency in the app at a rate you see before you exchange.

items.title: Transfers by phone number
items.text: Money arrives in seconds — all you need is the recipient’s phone number.

items.title: Up to 5% cashback
items.text: We return part of what you spend in cafés, taxis and online.

items.title: Business account
items.text: An account for sole traders and small companies: payments, statements and staff in one window.

items.title: Savings and goals
items.text: Save for a trip or new tech: round-ups on purchases and automatic top-ups.

items.title: QR payments
items.text: Pay in shops and for services by scanning the QR code at the till.

sections.label: Security
sections.title: Your money is protected
sections.text: You confirm every transaction: biometric login, one-time codes and instant card freezing with one tap. Data is encrypted in transit, and you get a notification for every charge right away. The card is issued by a partner bank; its name and details are in the agreement in the app.

items.q: How do I open an account?
items.a: Download the app, photograph your passport or ID card and complete the face check. It usually takes 5 minutes, and the virtual card appears right away.
The Standard plan is free, Plus is 29,000 UZS a month, Business is 99,000 UZS a month. Current terms are always shown in the app under “Plans”.

items.q: What are the transfer limits and fees?
items.a: Limits depend on your plan and identity verification. We show the exact amounts and fees in the app before you confirm a transfer.
Biometric login, code confirmation for transactions, instant card freezing in the app and a notification for every charge. The card is issued by a partner bank; its details are in the agreement.

items.q: Can I use the card abroad?
items.a: Yes, you can pay abroad and online with the Visa card. Spending in dollars or euros is taken from your currency account without double conversion.

items.q: What if I lose my phone?
items.a: Call support or log in from another device — the card will be frozen within a minute. The money in your account stays safe.
